input.goal: Make this existing repository navigable and prevent one recurring dependency-boundary regression.
acceptance: The repository map links to the actual build/test commands and architecture owner.
A regression test reproduces the selected boundary violation and rejects new violations.
Existing external behavior and the accepted baseline are preserved.
constraints: No whole-repository rewrite or formatting sweep.
Trusted CI policy and accepted baseline remain outside the candidate workspace.

work_units.instructions: Create a short navigation map and document existing boundaries, owners, trusted checks and known debt; preserve application behavior.
Add one focused architecture test for the accepted module boundary using the trusted baseline; do not change baseline policy.
